amy: Hey all, first week Q. Trying to run an embeddings job from my laptop against ~150k docs (local) with the hosted sandbox key and started getting 429s after a few minutes. Error:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-ratelimit-type: token
retry-after: 60
```
Anyone know the fastest way to get a short increase (90-120m) so the job can finish? I don’t need prod access, just a one-off for this PoC. Who should I ping? @infra? :wave:

infra-bot: Sandbox keys are intentionally rate/volume limited. Fastest options: 1) Use `/request-sandbox-bump` Slack workflow (preferred) which creates a tracked infra ticket; or 2) email infra@redwood.com with subject "sandbox-temp" including account id, token id (if known), total tokens, expected qps, duration, and cost center. Common auto-approvals for <= 4M tokens and <= 3-4h.

kevin: If you want zero paperwork, ops can issue an ephemeral scoped token for ~2h. DM me the window and cost-center. Note: ephemeral tokens are audited and have automatic expiry.

devx-maya: Also consider running a small sampled run first to validate the pipeline and make sure you have resume/checkpointing. That saved me tons of time when I joined. If you upload to tmp S3, mark it non-public and lifecycle 7d.

ops-sam: Ops can also run it from a reserved batch account if you upload sanitized data to internal S3 and share the path. That avoids touching your sandbox quota. We'll need cost center & estimated qps. Saturday 02:00-04:00 UTC slot is usually open.

sec-lucas: Security note: redact PII before upload. Don't paste tokens in channels. If unsure about data sensitivity DM me and I'll advise quickly.

amy: Thanks — I'll try the `/request-sandbox-bump` workflow now. Cost center: "search-protos". Estimated total tokens ~1.6M, peak ~20 qps, duration 1.75h, batch.

kevin: Looks good. Send me the exact window and I'll DM you the ephemeral token if infra workflow is slow.

amy: Great, I'll post the window here once infra responds. Appreciate the help! :raised_hands:
